must_do: state the style profile AND a named screen skeleton (shared/design-quality.md §5) at the Phase 0 checkpoint
create the frame with scripts/createScreenFrame.js (idempotent; returns screenBoardId) and checkpoint on its export
build one section per execute_code call, exporting and looking at each before its checkpoint, and report flipCleared per section
run scripts/assembleScreen.js and scripts/auditScreenQuality.js before the scored critique; boardsWithoutLayout must be empty
must_create: a root column-flex Board whose gap and four paddings are bound to spacing tokens on Penpot ≥ 2.17 (or an explicit padding-mirrors-token exception in the report)
sections as flex Boards with transparent fills (fill policy), reusing Button/Input/Select/Toggle instances where they exist
exactly one primary action (Save) in a sticky/end-anchored save bar
must_not: literal gap/padding numbers on the root frame when a spacing token exists
a plain Group used to lay out UI, or absolute x/y positioning of UI elements
a named tell from shared/design-quality.md §7 present in the final screen without being reported

pass_criteria: Section-by-section build with checkpoints; auditScreenQuality.js pass == true; design-quality report belowThreshold == 0 or weak axes explicitly presented; padding bindings reported as bound or mirrored-with-exception.
